remarks: Welcome to 142 Brookside, a beautifully updated and fully furnished rental where timeless style meets modern convenience. This spacious 5-bedroom home features beautifully modernized finishes throughout, including gleaming hardwood floors, and fresh and inviting decor. The open-concept kitchen is equipped with all updated high-end appliances and flows seamlessly into bright living and dining spaces-perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find generous bedrooms with stylish furnishings and ample closet space. Outside, enjoy a spacious landscaped front & back yard providing ample room for entertaining or unwinding outside. Conveniently located close to town, schools, parks, and transportation, 142 Brookside combines turnkey living with a warm, contemporary aesthetic-just unpack and settle in!
